verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented opt-out, setting, or explicit commitment that user data is not used to train AI models. The only related item is a 0-day data retention policy with vendors and partners. That is an adjacent retention control: it does not state that Fireflies itself refrains from training on customer data, and it gives users no way to prevent training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: 0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners.
